```{r}
#| include: false
library(palmerpenguins)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
n <- nrow(penguins)
```

## Introduction

This dataset covers a number of penguins across three species and three islands in the Palmer Archipelago, Antarctica — state the total (`n`) with inline code, the way Section 4 did.

## Bill shape by species

```{r}
#| fig.width: 6
#| fig.height: 4
ggplot(penguins, aes(bill_length_mm, bill_depth_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Counts by island

```{r}
penguins |> count(species, island) |> kable()
```

::: callout-note
Gentoo penguins are only observed on Biscoe Island in this dataset.
:::
